reason: The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web UI add-on that adds a right-edge conversation outline panel for chat turns, using DOM-based turn detection plus hover/scroll-driven highlighting and click-to-jump behavior; this is primarily a user-interface navigation enhancement, with no evidence of code generation, testing automation, or external service orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端新增右侧对话导航面板，按轮次展示记录，支持悬停展开并点击跳转到对应聊天轮次。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a right-side conversation outline panel in DeepSeek Harness web, showing chat turns and enabling hover expansion with one-click jump navigation.

capabilities: injects a web UI overlay into the host chat page
reads conversation DOM markers to detect user turns
tracks scroll position to highlight the current turn
provides click-to-jump navigation to specific turns
derives style values from host page variables

reasons.code: Web plugin client entry is explicitly integrated into the web runtime (`dsh.client` web platform), indicating direct browser execution context.
The plugin builds an outline from conversation DOM data attributes and supports navigation actions across turns.
README states that it tracks scroll state per frame and updates current-turn highlighting, which introduces continuous UI-state observation.
